from.name: IPv4 TOS → Differentiated Services field lineage

property: The same IPv4 header octet carries forward the DS field while its low two bits are assigned a new explicit-congestion role that also changes TCP feedback semantics.

sources.locator: RFC 3168 update list and ECN field definition

negative_claims: This edge does not claim ECN is simply another DSCP codepoint; it occupies distinct low-order bits with different semantics.
This edge does not claim the original RFC 791 TOS interpretation survived unchanged.
open_questions: Trace tunnel handling and AccECN descendants.
notes: One physical header location contains multiple semantic generations.
